PREFIX wd:       <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt:      <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs:     <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX bd:       <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX geo:      <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX geof:     <http://www.opengis.net/def/function/geosparql/>
PREFIX xsd:      <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?type ?typeLabel ?coord ?lat ?lon
WHERE {
  # Cultural POI classes taken from the configuration (poi_types):
  #   art gallery, library, monument, museum, theatre building
  VALUES ?type {
    wd:Q1007870   # art gallery
    wd:Q7075      # library
    wd:Q4989906   # monument
    wd:Q33506     # museum
    wd:Q24354     # theatre building
  }

  # The item is an instance of (or a subclass of) one of those classes
  ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?type .

  # Located in the configured city: Alicante (city_qid)
  ?item wdt:P131 wd:Q11959 .

  # Located in the configured country: Spain (country_qid).
  # OPTIONAL + FILTER so that items without a P17 statement are kept,
  # while any stated country must be Spain.
  OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?country . }
  FILTER ( (!BOUND(?country)) || (?country = wd:Q29) )

  # Coordinates
  ?item wdt:P625 ?coord .

  # Plain numeric latitude / longitude derived from the WKT literal
  BIND(geof:latitude(?coord)  AS ?lat)
  BIND(geof:longitude(?coord) AS ?lon)

  SERVICE wikibase:label {
    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,es,ca".
    ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabel .
    ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel .
  }
}
ORDER BY ?typeLabel ?itemLabel
LIMIT 500

- wikibase:label service with "en,es,ca" languages; ORDER BY + LIMIT 500.
- Explicit PREFIX declarations (wd, wdt, rdfs, bd, wikibase, geof) make the query self-contained.
